description: ARM NEON assembly implementation of cryptographic functions for Galois/Counter Mode (GCM) in BoringSSL, including initialization, multiplication, and GHASH functions.

methods.name: _gcm_init_neon
methods.description: Initializes the NEON registers for GCM, loading and processing the H value.

methods.name: _gcm_gmult_neon
methods.description: Performs Galois field multiplication using NEON instructions.

methods.name: _gcm_ghash_neon
methods.description: Computes GHASH using NEON instructions, processing input blocks.
